title: Huge security risks…
body: I downloaded and had a chance to play with the app. The app seems to work if one fills in all the information required to make the connection. However, the way this app works exposes a huge security risk because it requires the user to fill in all the security credentials including username, password and personal private key (if key-based connection is required). This seems very unsafe! I could try to be careful not losing my phone or letting someone peep into my phone’s content, but how am I supposed to trust this app which collects all these extremely sensitive information! Other well known apps like Putty, allows the user name and credential to be manually entered in during connection time. Until this app offers such means to enter one’s credentials, I would shy away from using it. Also, the free version only allow one connection profile.
